verdict.rationale: Stripe Terminal documents registering smart readers to an account by registration code, serial number, or order number. Serial-number registration can be done right after unboxing, and readers can be registered and managed from the Dashboard. Readers must be assigned to a location to accept payments, and no-code options let merchants take payments without building a POS. missing for 10: documented Bluetooth/SDK pairing flow with a POS app, hands-on or independent evidence of minutes-to-first-payment timing.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can pair a card reader with the POS app or register it to my account and take a payment within minutes

citations.quote: You can register smart readers in one of three ways: - Registration code - Serial number - Order number
This method doesn’t require someone to physically have the reader to register it, so you can use it immediately after you unbox it.
Reader management: Order, register, configure, and monitor readers from the Dashboard.
You must register your reader to a location to accept payments.
Accept in-person payments on a compatible reader using Stripe's no-code solution.
